attchmntText: Annu Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Annu Projects Limited has published the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The announcement was issued on November 14, 2026. The results were advertised in the Financial Express across all English editions and in Jansatta for the Delhi Hindi edition. The information is also available on the company website at https://annuprojects.com/newspaper-plublication/. The filing is made under Regulations 30 and 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. Sanjay Kumar Sarraf, Chairman and Managing Director, signed the notice. The company's Corporate Identification Number is L45201DL2003PLC120995. The registered office is located at Plot No.11, 1st Floor, LSC, Sector-B-1, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi-110070.

attchmntText: Annu Projects Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Annu Projects Limited filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of Rs. 35.65 crore for H1 FY27. EBITDA stood at Rs. 7 crore with an EBITDA margin of 19.64 percent. The order book as of September 2026 is Rs. 1,018.39 crore. There are 30 ongoing projects with an aggregate contract value of Rs. 1,987.90 crore. The company listed on the BSE and NSE in September 2026. Sanjay Kumar Sarraf serves as Chairman and Managing Director with DIN 01174144. The presentation covers business verticals including telecom infrastructure, sewerage infrastructure, gas pipeline, and railway signalling.

attchmntText: Annu Projects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press release on Un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year endedSeptember 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Annu Projects Limited filed a press release regarding its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations rose to 35.65 crore for H1 FY27, with EBITDA at 7 crore and a margin of 19.64%. Profit after tax stood at 2.29 crore. The order book reached 1,018.39 crore across 30 ongoing projects. The company listed on BSE and NSE on September 2, 2026, issuing up to 1.77 crore equity shares. It entered an MoU with GEIE for a 44.3 crore rooftop solar project. A 12.81 crore contract was secured from Northeast Frontier Railway. Sanjay Kumar Sarraf serves as Chairman and Managing Director with DIN 01174144.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency report issued by ACER Credit Rating private Limited for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Annu Projects Limited has filed the Monitoring Agency Report issued by ACER Credit Rating Private Limited regarding the utilization and application of funds raised through the Initial Public Offer for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The document has been uploaded to the company website at https://annuprojects.com/stock-exchange-disclosures/. The filing was signed by Sanjay Kumar Sarraf, Chairman and Managing Director, with DIN 01174144, on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Annu Projects Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Annu Projects Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. The meeting commenced at 05:00 P.M. and concluded at 06:55 P.M. The company has enclosed the Unaudited Financial Results along with the Limited Review Report. An extract of these results will be published in newspapers pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The trading window for dealing in the company's securities remains closed until 48 hours from this announcement. The information is available on the company website at https://annuprojects.com/financial-results-2026-27/. Sanjay Kumar Sarraf, Chairman and Managing Director, signed the communication.

attchmntText: Annu Projects Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of Earnings Conference Call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026'.
voiceSummary: Annu Projects Limited has announced an Earnings Conference Call to discuss operational and financial performance for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is scheduled for Tuesday, 17th November 2026, at 11:30 AM Indian Standard Time. This follows a Board of Directors meeting held on 13th November 2026, which was convened to approve the un-audited financial results. Participants include Sanjay Kumar Sarraf, Chairman and Managing Director, and Mayank Agarwal, Chief Financial Officer. Access details include primary numbers plus 91 22 6280 1102 and plus 91 22 7115 8003, along with toll-free lines for the USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong. The information will be hosted on the company website.
